finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the 'url' string contains shell metacharacters like ';' or '&&', it could inject and execute arbitrary commands on the system.
finding.assumptions: The 'url' parameter is directly appended to the command string without any sanitization or validation.
